section: Iterate — change: refresh RTM + test-evidence for stale compliance regen
title: Regenerate traceability-matrix.md and test-evidence.md for FR-01.21 + freshness
context: Phase-Quality flagged two Tier-1 FAILs: T1 (FR-01.21, added by the R1b Codex-hooks iterate, was missing from the RTM's Requirements Coverage table) and W3 (test-evidence.md's Source-State run was 11 days / 20+ merged commits stale, so it no longer named the latest work_completed run).
decision: Ran update_compliance.py --phase iterate to regenerate traceability-matrix.md, test-evidence.md, test-traceability.json, change-history.md, sbom.md and dashboard.md from current HEAD, inside a fresh iterate worktree rather than committing straight to main.
consequences: RTM now lists all 21 FRs incl. FR-01.21; test-evidence.md's Source-State matches the latest iterate work_completed event (R1b). No source/behavior change; a pure derived-artifact refresh.
